title: RealityCheck Evidence Record
description: Schema for a single RealityCheck finding. Preserves the complete requirement → reproduction → repair → verification chain.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Always '1.0' for this release.

run_id.description: Identifier grouping all executions for this verification run.

finding_id.description: Unique identifier for this finding within the run.

text.description: Full text of the requirement as written in the contract.

classification.description: How confidently the requirement is grounded in documentation.

kind.description: Distinguishes the type of source document.

artifact.description: Path or name of the source artifact.

locator.description: Section heading, line range, or anchor within the artifact.

excerpt.description: Short verbatim quote or paraphrase from the source.

assumption.description: The implementation assumption identified as diverging from the requirement.

code_artifact.description: Path to the source file containing the assumption.

symbol.description: Qualified name of the function, class, or symbol.

counterexample.description: A concrete input that demonstrates the divergence.

fixture.description: Path to the fixture file containing the counterexample.

record_ids.description: Identifiers of the specific records within the fixture.

expected_behavior.description: What the application should do according to the contract.

decision.description: Developer decision on the requirement + counterexample + regression test.

reviewer.description: Identity of the developer who made the acceptance decision.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the acceptance decision.

protected_manifest.description: Path to the protected manifest file created at acceptance.

regression.description: The regression test accepted to cover this finding.

test_artifact.description: Path to the regression test file.

node_ids.description: Pytest node IDs to execute for reproduction and verification.

expected_failure.description: Plain-language description of the expected failure mode before repair.

executions.description: References to execution artifacts. Reproduction and verification are preserved separately.

oneOf.description: Information about the repair applied to the application.

base_snapshot.description: Snapshot ID of the application before repair.

candidate_snapshot.description: Snapshot ID of the application after repair.

verdict.description: Deterministic verdict derived from execution records.

status.description: Verdict status. 'verified_for_tested_scenarios' is the highest positive verdict; no 'production_safe' verdict exists.

reason.description: Plain-language explanation of why this verdict was reached.

limitations.description: Explicit limitations or caveats on the verdict.

oneOf.description: Reference to an execution artifact directory.

artifact_dir.description: Relative path to the execution artifact directory.
